A witness you named as trusted signed for the seal at entry 5, which covers the first 5 entries. This book starts from a permission signed by a passkey you named, every permission before the seal is from that passkey for the same agent, and the book is sealed by a recorder you named. For that recorder, that passkey and the agent the permission names, the witness states that it saw this seal, and that it will sign for no seal that does not extend it, in this book or a later one, whichever permission from that passkey to that agent the book starts from. So a second history of those entries, sealed by the same recorder and starting from a permission that passkey gave that agent, shown to someone else, would need that witness to sign for it too. It does not cover a history sealed with other keys, even keys you also named, nor one that starts from a permission for another agent. It does not show when the seal was made, that nothing was cut off after a later seal, nor anything never shown to the witness: to see whether the end of the book is missing, ask the witness for the latest seal it holds for this recorder, passkey and agent, and hand that seal over beside the book it is of.
